motivation.text: Put your shoes on before you decide. The decision can catch up on the walk.

discipline.text: The work does not care how you feel. Sit down and start anyway.

money.text: Money follows patience, not noise. Spend with purpose, save with silence, own what lasts.

mindset.text: The mountain does not move for you, but the path changes with each step you take.

fact.text: Botanically, bananas are berries, while strawberries are not true berries.

books.text: Large groups cooperate because they believe in the same stories.
books.credit: Idea from Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind by Yuval Noah Harari

stoic.text: What unsettles you is not the event itself but the story you attach to it.
